text.p: Anglo-Australian drugs group Cortecs International Ltd said on Monday that results of phase I drug trials for macrulin oral insulin were encouraging and it was now planning a Phase IIa macrulin trial.
It said the phase IIa trial in diabetics was planned for the third quarter of this year after an orginal target date of the second quarter.
Cortecs also said that phase I trials of its Flustat oral influenza vaccine were "on the right track", after safely introducing the vaccine into normal humans.
It said that at doses of the order of 10 percent of those included in commercial injected vaccines, both local and systemic immune responses had been observed.

"Our objective is to produce an effective oral influenza vaccine with minimum inconvenience and side effects. It is therefore encouraging to see responses at such low doses," said Cortecs president Michael Flynn.
Shares in the company showed little response to the announcement, gaining just 1/2p to 184p.
